name: Alpro Oat Milk
description: Sourced from European oat farms committed to regenerative agriculture. Alpro's oat milk uses 60% less water than dairy and generates significantly lower carbon emissions. The packaging is fully recyclable and made from plant-based materials.

name: KitKat Original
description: A classic chocolate wafer bar produced by Nestlé. Cocoa sourced through the Nestlé Cocoa Plan, though ongoing concerns about deforestation and child labour in the supply chain persist. Palm oil used in production has been linked to habitat destruction.

name: Dove Body Wash
description: Dove's gentle skin cleanser uses mild surfactants and is part of Unilever's Sustainable Living Plan. The brand has committed to 100% recycled plastic bottles by 2025, though palm oil sourcing remains a concern across Unilever's supply chain.

name: Annie's Mac & Cheese
description: Annie's organic macaroni and cheese uses organic wheat pasta and real cheese from grass-fed cows. General Mills has committed to sourcing Annie's ingredients from regenerative farmland, supporting soil health and biodiversity.

name: Evian Spring Water
description: Naturally filtered spring water from the French Alps. While Evian has achieved carbon neutrality and uses some recycled PET, the fundamental model of bottling and shipping water raises environmental questions about plastic waste and transport emissions.

name: Lay's Classic Chips
description: Lay's Classic potato chips are made from specially grown potatoes. PepsiCo's Frito-Lay division has faced scrutiny over water usage in drought-prone farming regions and single-use plastic packaging that is not widely recyclable.

name: Coca-Cola Original
description: The world's most recognized soft drink. Coca-Cola has been identified as the world's top plastic polluter by Break Free From Plastic for multiple consecutive years. While the company has pledged to collect and recycle a bottle for every one sold by 2030, progress has been slow.

name: Snickers Bar
description: A chocolate bar with nougat, caramel, and peanuts. Mars has committed to 100% sustainable cocoa through its Cocoa for Generations programme, but reports indicate ongoing deforestation links. The company has improved factory emissions but faces criticism over sugar marketing practices.

name: Kraft Singles
description: Processed American cheese slices. Kraft Heinz has faced criticism for highly processed ingredients, factory farming supply chains, and slow progress on sustainability commitments. The company's environmental footprint remains among the highest in the packaged food industry.

name: Patagonia Provisions Soup
description: Organic soup made with regeneratively sourced ingredients. Patagonia Provisions exemplifies the company's commitment to fixing the food chain. All ingredients are sourced from farms practising regenerative organic agriculture, and packaging is designed for minimal waste.

name: Scoobi Doo Pasta
description: Scoobi Doo Pasta is a fun, kid‑shaped durum wheat pasta made by Unico under Sun‑Brite Foods. While the parent company’s ethical practices are not fully disclosed, the product contains no artificial additives and is typically packaged in recyclable material.
